text: TE32.76, which was moved at the April meeting of Toronto East York Community Council contained incorrect boundary information related to the proposed installation of speed bumps. By way of re-opening this item, I am requesting that Traffic Operations staff amend TE32.76, as per the recommendations, regarding the installation of speed bumps on the east-west public lane bounded by Wallace Avenue, Emerson Avenue, Armstrong Avenue and Dufferin Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened item TE32.76 – "Speed Bump Installation on the East-West Public Lane bounded by Wallace Avenue, Emerson Avenue, Armstrong Avenue and Dufferin Street." 2. Rescinded the decision on item TE32.76.
